description: What a company's executives are paid against how it did, from the pay-versus-performance table in its proxy: the CEO's reported pay and the pay actually earned, the other executives' averages, shareholder return against peers, net income and the company's chosen measure, five years; or every company's CEO pay ranked, with mis-scaled filings held out.

company.description: Ticker, CIK or name. Without it, every company that tagged a pay-versus-performance table for the year, ranked.

limit.description: Across the market, most companies to list; default 25.

rank_by.description: Across the market: the CEO's reported pay (default), pay actually paid, or total shareholder return.

year.description: Across the market, the fiscal year (by calendar year); default last year.

name: executive_pay

outputSchema.description: rows are fiscal years (one company, newest first) or companies (the market, ranked), in the order of columns; pay in dollars, TSR as the value of $100.

title: Executive pay vs performance
